architecture.mechanism: AI-assisted decision systems that reason over digital evidence (controller event logs, sensor and actuator state) to detect anomalous subsystem behavior and trigger governed, fail-safe interventions.
architecture.intervention: Add an AI-assisted decision supervisor to the auto-start-stop controller that continuously forensic-analyzes battery state-of-health, crank/thermal evidence and restart-readiness, and only permits start-stop disengagement when a safe engine restart is guaranteed; otherwise it holds the engine running.
architecture.expected_effect: Removes uncommanded auto-start-stop disengagement and engine stalling while preserving fuel-saving operation and guaranteeing safe restart during traffic stops.
architecture.falsification_test: On a vehicle or HIL bench with the R510 blind-yield battery fault injected, command traffic-stop cycles; the mechanism is falsified if the engine stalls, restart latency exceeds the specified safe-restart limit, or disengagement is permitted without a verified restart-ready state.

challenge.kill_reason: all checks passed: evidence verified, no specific disclosure, adversarial survived, falsification concrete
